test_definition: Clean two-source proposition identity produces one candidate.
Same proposition with different ordinal scales produces response variants and no value mapping.
Trust in police and trust in courts remain separate sibling families.
Past petition signing and willingness to sign remain separate families.
Environment-growth and climate-growth remain separate or hierarchical.
Derived index remains separate from constituent questions.
Structure analogy without proposition authority cannot create a family.
Heterogeneous lineage requires segmentation or blocking.
Adding coordinate edges cannot join components.
Removing a positive edge cannot enlarge a component.
Adding a hard negative cannot improve candidate status.
Reordering input rows cannot change stable IDs or outputs.
All internal candidate pairs equal n*(n-1)/2.
Every unruled internal pair appears in closure obligations.
Every canonical member has implementation-level provenance.
Every accepted family has at least one rule-based exclusion.
A superseded family cannot appear in current release views.
Value-portability blocks survive canonical family acceptance.
Corrupt a target and require split or hard failure.
Corrupt an operator and prohibit proposition identity.
Remove a P2 ruling ID and fail closed.
Insert unknown vocabulary code and fail schema validation.
Duplicate a normalized object ID and fail.
Create a cycle in supersession genealogy and fail.
Delete a candidate member evidence record and fail.
Change collision scope from value-only to family-wide and force impact recalculation.
Allow a coordinate edge into connectivity graph and fail.
Attempt direct canonical approval from DISCOVERED and fail.
Change artifact dependency without dirty-set propagation and fail.
Blank evidence must not satisfy a required gate.
Pilot clean-equivalence fixtures remain stable unless doctrine delta is explicit.
Pilot response-variant fixtures remain stable unless doctrine delta is explicit.
Pilot collision and non-transitive fixtures remain stable unless doctrine delta is explicit.
Pilot heterogeneous-lineage fixtures remain stable unless doctrine delta is explicit.
Fresh extraction reproduces all canonical and derived artifact hashes.
PostgreSQL DDL parses and enforces key/check constraints in test database when installed.
Shadow release comparison returns exact added/removed/changed families.
